title: DefinitionClaimContribution
description: Post payload of a Contribution posted onto the Definition panel with slot = Claim. An IdentificationKS asserts that one identityKey of one subjectKind defines a GSM subject (Structure, Mechanism, Effector, Receptor, Interaction, Archetype, Directive, Norm), backed by the listed source items. The Definition panel is the join key for every other target panel.

identityKey.description: Stable identity key for the GSM subject (client-defined naming convention).

supportingSourceIds.description: Ids of itip:Repository / itip:Index / itip:Framework / itip:Iac / itip:CodeGraph contributions supporting this Claim.
